# Twelve:21 Braids & Crowns

> Hair salon in Orlando, Florida (3701 John Young Pkwy, Suite 100-7, Orlando, FL 32804, Princeton / Silver Star area). Owner and stylist: Vanessa. Silk press, knotless and feed-in braids, locs (retwists, faux locs, starter locs, reties), natural hair styles, sleek ponytails and quick weaves. By appointment, booked online through Acuity. Rated 5.0 on Google from 135 reviews. Slogan: "Precision & Quality lives here!"

Facts checked on 12 Oct 2026 against the Acuity booking page, Google Business Profile, Instagram and Linktree.

## Policies (summary)
- A non-refundable deposit is required to book and is applied to the final total.
- Balance payment: Zelle, cash, Cash App, Apple Pay, Afterpay.
- Clients must be 12 or older. Hair must be at least 4 inches long. No extra persons during appointments.
- Reschedule or cancel 24 hours prior; one reschedule allowed, then a new deposit. No call/no show/same-day cancellation: deposit forfeited and 100% payment, no future bookings.
- Sick policy: reschedule or cancel 24 hours prior; cancellations/no-shows forfeit the deposit plus 50% of the service.
- Late: 10 minutes $10, 15 minutes $20, 20 minutes reschedule unless a shorter style is possible.
- Emergency / squeeze-in appointments (outside normal hours, days off, last minute): +30% of the style total, paid before scheduling.
- Every client is photographed before, during and after ("Come camera ready"); tell Vanessa if you do not want your face shown.
- Email confirmation at booking; text reminder 24 to 48 hours before. All style times are estimates.

Notes: Silk press includes deep cleanse, condition, hydrate, blow out and press. Loc retwists are based on 125 or fewer locs and 3/4 in. or less of new growth, shampoo included. Miracle Knotless: client brings 3 to 5 bundles of human feather crochet hair. Classy and Edgy knotless and Faux Locs include hair. Starter locs require a consultation first.

## FAQ
- How do I book? Online at https://twelve21braidsandcrowns.as.me/ with a non-refundable deposit.
- How much is a silk press? $120 to $165 by length and density.
- How much is a loc retwist? $100 to $225 by length and style.
- Do you braid kids? Clients must be 12 or older.
- Not sure what to book? A 20-minute consultation is $25.
